Remote Job Board

Remote, US-eligible roles at 30 companies, ranked against your resume. Snapshot from 2026-11-11.

Company

      Match % compares each posting with your resume: title fit (frontend, product, full-stack), seniority, and skills the posting names (React, TypeScript, accessibility, A/B testing). It is a guide, not a verdict. "Also mentions" lists tools in the posting that are not on your resume. Salary bands come from the posting or its description and can cover several locations; "No band listed" means none was found. Company sizes come from Y Combinator team sizes or from directory entries added or updated since 2025. Where neither is current the size is left blank, shown as "size unknown", and never assumed small; use "Include unknown size" to see those companies when filtering by size. Only remote roles are included, and identical titles posted in several locations are collapsed into one row. Listings posted more than 60 days ago are left out. Posting dates are by day, so "Last 24 hours" means posted today or yesterday. Status, notes and role tracking stay in this browser only.
